Pratiksha finds divorce papers and decides to leave. Caught by Kavya, she fights back and tears the documents to pieces, forcing Kavya to plan her next move.

Lois und Hal gelingt es nicht, einen Kindertagesstättenplatz für Jamie zu finden. So melden sie sich kurzerhand bei einer Gemeinde, damit die Mitglieder sich um das Baby kümmern können. Doch sie bereuen ihre Entscheidung schon schnell.

Die Familie fährt ab nach Texas unter dem Vorwand einer Kaninchenshow, obwohl Deweys fettes Kaninchen keine Chance hat. Hal knackt den Jackpot und Lois ist außer sich vor Begeisterung von der Show ihres Helden Boone Vincent.

Ein Missgeschick mit einem undichten Warmwasserbereiter droht die Weihnachtsfeiertage zu ruinieren, während Sam und Jay sich darauf vorbereiten, Jays anspruchsvollen Vater, seine schwer zu beeindruckende Mutter und seine Schwester Bela zu bewirten.
Bastian, Hagen und Volker Pastewka weilen immer noch irgendwo in der tiefsten Eifel, doch nachdem sie Therapeut Ecki tot aufgefunden haben, liegen die Nerven blank.
Josh Johnson begrüßt Danielle Brooks, die den Film "If I Go Will They Miss Me" vorstellt.

Francine steigt zur erfolgreichen Immobilienmaklerin auf, was Stan in seiner Männlichkeit kränkt, weil sie plötzlich weit mehr als er verdient. Um den Status quo wieder herzustellen, ist Stan zu den radikalsten Mitteln bereit, inklusive eines Kidnappings ins berüchtigte Gefangenencamp Guantánamo.

Stan kritisiert Hayleys Freund und lässt ihn in ordentlicher CIA-Manier entführen, um die Beziehung zwischen ihm und seiner Tochter zu beenden, woraufhin sich Hayley dazu entschließt, aus Protest Stripperin zu werden. Primär entbrennt aber erst mal ein Kampf um die Haarfarbe von Hayley.

Bender wollte schon immer ein Folk-Star werden. Mithilfe eines 3D-Druckers hat er sich eine Gitarre seines Idols nachgebaut und schreibt seine eigenen Songs. Allerdings werden seine Texte durch den Drucker lebendig und sorgen für Chaos.

Bei einem Minenunfall kann Bender einen Brand löschen und dadurch mehrere Arbeiter retten. Nach seiner Ernennung zum Feuerwehrmann in New York werden die Menschen schnell misstrauisch. Immer dort, wo Bender auftaucht, beginnt ein Brand.

Halloween steht kurz bevor und Louise behauptet, dass sie sich noch nie richtig gefürchtet hat. Das nehmen Bob und Linda zum Anlass, ein ganz besonders schauriges Fest zu veranstalten. Sie planen die Besichtigung eines Spukhauses.

Bob muss an Thanksgiving die verletzte Gayle abholen, doch ein Schneesturm erschwert den Heimweg. Dadurch geraten die Feierlichkeiten in Gefahr, denn Bob ist für die Zubereitung des Truthahns zuständig.
Cartman betrachtet sich als den ultimativen Restaurant-Online-Bewerter in South Park.
Cartman wird wegen seines Körpers das Ziel negativer Kommentare. Er bekommt bald Unterstützung.

Um einen Rivalen bei der Arbeit loszuwerden, lädt Stan seinen Boss zu einem vergnüglichen Abendessen nach Hause ein. Stan diskreditiert den Kollegen als Terroristen, weil dieser beim Pita-Sandwich-Essen fotografiert wurde.

Stan wird misstrauisch, als er bemerkt, dass sein gesprächiger Nachbar Tuttle seinen Rasen nicht sprengt. Fortan schleicht er durch die Nachbarschaft, um dem Nachbar etwas nachweisen zu können. Die Erkenntnisse sind für Stan mehr als schockierend, bemerkt er doch, dass in der direkten Nachbarschaft US-Amerikaner mit arabischer Herkunft leben.
Ray can't help but enjoy the extra attention his mother lavishes on him when he feels under the weather.
Ray buys Debra an elaborate Christmas present in the hope that she will consequently let him go on a golfing weekend, but he hasn't anticipated the present she's getting him.
Ray tries to prove to everyone that he can be counted on after failing to help Debra when she chokes.
Ray is sent to cover the Super Bowl by his newspaper, but his excitement is tempered by having to choose someone to accompany him.
Sabrina and Harvey's plans for a romantic ski weekend are thwarted when they are trapped in a snowstorm with Brad.
Sabrina organises a date for Salem's high-school reunion - Juliette, a totally selfish but beautiful cat.
During the Christmas holidays, Sabrina magically erases winter so she can enjoy a Jamaican holiday, but an angry mother nature turns her into a snowman.

Desperate for her and Harvey to win the cutest couple at the Winter Ball, Sabrina becomes obsessed with her body image and goes on a crash diet. However, it goes wrong when she loses too much weight and disappears.
The guys compete head-to-head posing odd TV shows to the public, and do what they are told at a department store. Tonight's punishment involves a fundraising event at an Arts Theatre.
The guys do and say whatever they are told while posing as dentists, and then compete head-to-head in trying not to laugh while the other makes a hilarious scene at a donut shop.

Ross applies for a palaeontology grant, but discovers that Dr Hobart - who allocates such funding - used to go out with his girlfriend Charlie. Meanwhile, Mike wants Phoebe to get rid of one of her bizarre paintings, but neither Rachel nor Monica is keen to take it, and Chandler lies to Joey about watching his audition tape.
Monica and Chandler fuss over their apartment as they expect a visit from the adoption worker. Meanwhile, Phoebe and Mike opt for a small wedding and donate the extra money to a children's charity.

Monica reluctantly agrees to cook Thanksgiving dinner, but locks everyone out when they turn up late as Joey and Ross went to a hockey game while Rachel and Phoebe took Emma to a baby beauty contest. Monica also receives some adoption news.

Monica and Chandler are forced to pretend to be a reverend and a doctor when their prospective child's birth mother gets the wrong end of the stick. Meanwhile, Joey's date with Phoebe's friend doesn't go well, and Ross is left with an inappropriate outfit for a date with a sexy salesgirl.
Phoebe and Rachel see Chandler getting into a car with a mystery woman and follow them to a large house in the suburbs. They tell Monica of their fears and are shocked by the truth.
Mike considers adopting a baby abandoned at a press conference, and Mike's old girlfriends voice opinions about him.
The mayor's masculine image suffers some damage when he, Mike, and Paul are mugged by a teenage girl; Stuart loses his heart to Deidre.

It's Valentine's Day and, out on his first date in nine years, Ross meets up with his ex-wife. Meanwhile, Monica, Phoebe and Rachel rebel against the spirit of the day by burning mementos of past relationships.
Phoebe doesn't get on with her identical twin Ursula. Unfortunately, no one can tell them apart, which leads to a few cases of mistaken identity, not least for Joey who is quite taken with Ursula.
After weeks of procrastinating, Rachel finally takes down the Christmas lights, but sprains her ankle.
Someone is pretending to be Monica, using her credit card numbers and having the sort of fun that Monica wishes she could have.
The show that lifts the lid on the funnier side of crime. Including mayhem in a fireworks shop, traffic cone theft, and a digger driver's revenge.
We have bad delivery drivers, sleepy security guards, and Santa puts himself on the naughty list.
The guys run a surprise hide and seek challenge, a stint at the Cake Boss' counter is anything but sweet, and advice for children turns awkward when heard by strangers.
The guys try not to laugh at gags behind a glass mirror and head to the top of Rockefeller Plaza to get opinions on their wedding proposals.
Robert is seeing a 22-year-old girl, and Debra and Marie think he's being foolish, but Ray and Frank aren't so sure. But she may not really be 22.
Debra's parents come round for Thanksgiving dinner. Debra's so pleased that they're not like Frank and Marie.
Ray can't help but enjoy the extra attention his mother lavishes on him when he feels under the weather.
Ray buys Debra an elaborate Christmas present in the hope that she will consequently let him go on a golfing weekend, but he hasn't anticipated the present she's getting him.
Ray tries to prove to everyone that he can be counted on after failing to help Debra when she chokes.
A senior citizen wields an unusual weapon, her mouth; a suspected criminal uses a local police station as a drive through; a man in a crazy costume takes police on a wild chase.
A defendant strips naked; the family of a murder victim attacks.
Doctor Harold Shipman was convicted of killing 15 patients in 2000, but he is thought to have killed up to 215. Discover how he was eventually caught by detectives.
Several bodies were discovered buried in the back garden of the home of Rose and Fred West in 1994, and it was learned that most of their victims died following episodes of sadistic rape and torture.
On 19 August 1987, Michael Ryan went on a bloody rampage in the village of Hungerford. Ryan shot and killed 16 people, and his crime would change the face of Britain forever.

When a woman is found dead in the woods, she is the assumed victim of a tragic hunting accident, but dogged police work uncovers a shocking truth that shakes the peaceful existence of a small, tight-knit village.

The Colegroves are beloved in their small town, but when they're brutally murdered in what appears to be a targeted attack, a bitter dispute within their family is revealed, pitting the surviving brothers against each other.

After the owner of an extreme-sport venture is found shot dead in his warehouse, police suspect a history of bad business may be to blame until a contentious family past begins to cast doubt on his devoted son's innocence.

An unusual 911 call leaves investigators sorting fact from fiction in the search for a missing mother. While police begin to expect the worst, an illicit affair at the heart of the victim's family reveals a daughter with something to hide.
Dianne Hood, a mother of three, is shot to death on her way home.
In Mobile, Alabama, two men are killed after their car is sprayed with bullets on the motorway, leading detectives across the country searching for answers.

When a woman is found dead in the woods, she is the assumed victim of a tragic hunting accident, but dogged police work uncovers a shocking truth that shakes the peaceful existence of a small, tight-knit village.

We revisit three cases with interrogations that could make or break the investigation. First, detectives must outwit a stonewalling suspect following a deadly Tulsa shooting. Then, a homicide investigator makes a last-ditch effort.
When a college student goes missing in suburban Georgia, a bloody discovery triggers an explosive manhunt and a dramatic chase for the truth.

Flash heads to Philadelphia to help Paul, who returns from a stint in Vegas to start a family with his fiancée, only to find a stranger has taken over his Pennsylvania home. When Flash confronts multiple occupants, tensions mount.
The Border Force discover cardboard packaging that hides a deadly secret, and heroin disguised as a computer laptop baffles the most advanced narcotic detection device.

Rick visits the home of new Nordic cuisine, Copenhagen, where groundbreaking chefs create artful dishes and religiously stick to seasonal Danish ingredients. Rick goes foraging for rosehip and learns about the art of pickling buds, bark and flowers.

Rick Stein heads to southern Spain and the historic city of Cadiz. Rick is captivated by its narrow winding streets as he walks in the footsteps of the ancient Phoenician and Arab traders whose influence on the city can still be seen today.

Freddie, Chris and Paddy head out on an icy expedition across the wild Scottish Highlands in the new Land Rover Defender, Mercedes G-Wagen and Ariel Nomad. Find out which one will prove itself the ultimate off-roader.

Freddie, Chris and Paddy confront the male midlife crisis by buying the perfect sports cars for 'gentlemen of a certain age'. Back at the track, Chris tests out the raucous new Toyota GR Yaris hot hatch.

Paul and Bob arrive in the Republic of Ireland, and they're kicking off their all-out Irish fishing trip on the River Finn. It's their first time fishing the rivers of both the Republic of Ireland and Northern Ireland.

Guy Martin teams up with the Black Country Living Museum to breathe new life into a Newcomen engine, a historically significant steam-powered machinery used in coal mines across Britain and the rest of Europe.

As an island, Britain is blessed with a plentiful and diverse supply of produce from the sea. Dave and Si celebrate Britain's love of fish and shellfish and find out the history of Billingsgate Market.

Paul, Bob, and Ted travel to Driffield Beck at Mulberry Whin in East Riding of Yorkshire to catch brown trout. They get started, but are slightly distracted by Ted, who is obsessed with rolling in the mud on the riverbank.
The guests joining Lee Mack and David Mitchell areLiz Carr, Miles Jupp, Samson Kayo and Anneka Rice.
The guests joining Lee Mack and David Mitchell are Greg Davies, Guz Khan, Claudia Winkleman and Lucy Worsley.
Detectives Leo and Bella investigate a case leading them into London's criminal underworld. As they seek answers, personal and professional boundaries fade amid twists and betrayals.

p.t: Have I Got a Bit More News for You
p.d: Professor Hannah Fry is host, with guest panellists actor Stephen Mangan and journalist Zing Tsjeng joining team captains Paul Merton and Ian Hislop as they delve into the news.

With fire season looming, Jared is under the gun to get all his product out of the woods before it turns to ash. Fallers race to drop trees without sparking a back country blaze and an alarming discovery at float camp could sink the whole operation.

Marine scientists in Florida hire engineers Nicolas Derouin and Arnaud Luguet to create a first-of-its-kind floating home; they have nine months to complete it, but unpredictable weather and building hiccups may sink this project before it can swim.

A couple plans to build an oceanfront oasis for their family in Maui, Hawaii and, to keep the budget low, they design a Quonset hut which can be built cheaply and quickly, but unexpected setbacks test their limits at every turn.

Mkhaya, the youngest baby elephant in the Safari Park herd, learns to use her trunk. Alba the Andean bear is a potential first-time mother, and zoo vets examine Mandazzi the gorilla. Jeff the Snake Chaser looks for the costal patch nose snake.

A southern white rhino is pregnant with a calf that could be key in saving a species from extinction; Connor the Malayan tiger has tooth trouble; a new bird keeper learns to feed the shoebill; polar bears exercise their hunting skills on live prey.
The buyers take a gamble on vintage casino and advertising items, including a Bob's Big Boy statue, in Vegas. Meanwhile, a rare Elvis recording could pay off big time.
A giant Gatling gun and a rare advertising piece from Nabisco Cookies are among the items that interest the buyers at a gambling auction in Las Vegas.
A lost property auction reveals an old-school boom box from the 1980s, while a buyer is over the rainbow about a rare 'Wizard of Oz' piece in a sealed trunk.
A once-in-a-lifetime auction in South Africa, a ceremonial mask from the Congo, and an item worth $10,000.

After Hurricane Helene obliterates a 100-year-old farmhouse in NC, a once self-sufficient family is left with nothing. The Raneys face their most urgent mission yet: to rebuild a fourth-generation homestead, making it 100% self-sustainable.
Mike and Ant drag a rare 1972 Datsun 510 2-door into the 21st century. The engine is in good order, but the bad paint job, gearbox and bodywork let it down.
Mike finds one of only 1,000 MC40s ever made, the 40th anniversary homage to the Monte Carlo rally-winning British icon. Ant must tackle this challenge head one to revive it to its original look.
In Rome, a couple is sent to the hospital after smuggling drugs inside their bodies. Meanwhile, in Frankfurt, a passenger is found carrying a hoard of undeclared phones.
In Algeciras, Spain, a clandestine eel hatchery is dismantled. Meanwhile, in Brussels, whitening creams containing illegal, carcinogenic ingredients are confiscated.

Most of the world is uncharted wilderness and untamed backcountry full of rugged terrain and wild inhabitants. It takes a special kind of police officer to survive and thrive as they take down criminals, prevent catastrophes and save lives.

As fire season draws closer and threatens widespread shutdowns, Jared's feeling the heat -- he races to salvage logs before it's too late. At Grizzly River, fallers Jim and Rob are called in to help clear a path to one last stand of money trees.

The hidden secrets of iconic structures and monuments from around the globe are revealed through scientific investigation and CGI animation.
We join contemporary treasure hunter Drew Pritchard as he travels across Britain in search of strange and wonderful objects. The bigger the find, the happier he gets.
In the south of England, Drew visits some collectors who specialise in natural objects. And he is not disappointed by their collections.
Explore the violent formation of our solar system, and look forward to its eventual death, and, what do other planetary systems around far-flung stars look like?

A couple finds massive footprints near Nancy Lake, strange lights circle above Fairbanks in coordinated patterns, shocking witnesses, and a picturesque rainbow camouflages an extraterrestrial teleportation device.

Josh hunts down new evidence on the iconic disappearance of Amelia Earhart in a two-hour special. He first treks to uncharted tribal lands of PNG, then ends his journey in Fiji, hoping to uncover the human remains of Amelia.
Phil and Jess investigate Utah's Uintah Basin, a region teeming with paranormal activity - including numerous UFO sightings, cattle mutilations and reports of shape-shifting creatures.

Don Wildman examines the stories of the man who saved George Washington, as well as the stories of Rosa Parks, a leading civil rights pioneer. Don also inspects the bizarre sighting of the Black Knight UFO.
Don Wildman examines a gambling geek who cheated Vegas, an alchemist performing an eccentric experiment and a harrowing journey through Nazi territory.
For 20 years NASA's Cassini spacecraft revealed Saturn's strange secrets until it vaporised in its atmosphere. Now, fresh data points to new discoveries.

The harrowing story of the schoolboy soccer team who found themselves lost in a remote cave in northern Thailand, and the incredible race against time to rescue them, with a look at every angle of the rescue operation.

Bruce is keen to find some World War Two objects linked to D-Day and in doing so makes an amazing discovery.

The hidden secrets of iconic structures and monuments from around the globe are revealed through scientific investigation and CGI animation.

Explore the violent formation of our solar system, and look forward to its eventual death, and, what do other planetary systems around far-flung stars look like?

Die Zwangsvollstrecker begeben sich in dieser Sendung in den Londoner Stadtteil Fulham, um umgerechnet etwa 8.300 Euro einzuholen. Der Schuldner, der einst bei „Ich bin ein Star - Holt mich hier raus!" mitmachte, saß bereits im Gefängnis.

Der Inhaber eines Brautmodengeschäfts weigert sich, seinen Dienstleister zu bezahlen, weil er mit dessen Arbeit nicht zufrieden ist. Als er auch nach einem Gerichtsurteil nicht zahlt, statten ihm die Gerichtsvollzieher einen Besuch ab.

Nach seinem Unfall muss Mat seinen Wagen abschleppen. Doch der LKW, der seinen Offroader zieht, bleibt wenig später stecken. Andrea will in Deutschland derweil eine riesige Waschanlage bauen, um in einem Kieswerk nach Gold zu schürfen.

Andreas hat den Plan gefasst, mit der frisch fertiggestellten Waschanlage nach Gold zu suchen. Mat schürft derweil mit seinem Bruder am Palmer River nach Goldnuggets. Leider ist der Fund nicht groß genug, um ihre Rechnungen zu begleichen.

p.t: Fang des Lebens - Der gefährlichste Job Alaskas
p.d: Kapitän Keith Colburn traut in Alaska seinen Augen kaum: Einer seiner Männer ist gerade nur mit einer Unterhose bekleidet in die zwei Grad kalte Beringsee gesprungen. Deckhand Freddy Maugatai hat im Wasser ein totes Walross entdeckt und will eine Leine an dem Kadaver befestigen, um ihn an Deck zu befördern. Der Seemann hat es auf die Stoßzähne des Tieres abgesehen.

p.t: Fang des Lebens - Der gefährlichste Job Alaskas
p.d: Eines der Fangboote in der Beringsee hat einen Notruf an die Zentrale der US-Küstenwache gesendet. Ein Krabbenfischer ist an Deck mit seiner Hand in den Köder-Schredder geraten. Doch über die Hafenstadt Saint Paul weht ein heftiger Schneesturm hinweg. Der Rettungshubschrauber kann bei diesen widrigen Bedingungen nicht starten. Also müssen sich Brandon Himeys Kollegen um die stark blutende Wunde kümmern.

p.t: Border Control: Türkei - Grenzschützer im Einsatz
p.d: Am Hafen von Ambarlı trifft ein Container aus Madagaskar auf dem Zollgelände ein. Laut Frachtpapieren befinden sich darin Reinigungsmittel, doch auf dem Röntgenbild ist neben der palettierten Ladung auch lose Ware zu erkennen.

Am Hafen in Stockholm tummeln sich viele junge Leute. Die Schüler wollen auf einer Kreuzfahrt ausgelassen ihren Abschluss feiern. Haben die Party-Gäste Drogen im Gepäck? In Göteborg trägt ein Passagier aus Istanbul teuren Schmuck bei sich.

Ein Ladenbesitzer ist offenbar in Geldnot. Deshalb möchte der Mann in Offenburg seinen Porsche beleihen. In Karlsruhe muss Lalka Marinova eine Dame mit zu hohen Erwartungen enttäuschen. In Siegburg steht eine Versteigerung auf der Agenda.

Ausnahmezustand im Pfandhaus: Nach einer Reihe von Überfällen in den vergangenen Jahren ist es für die Familie Bode in Siegburg an der Zeit, ihr Sicherheitskonzept weiterzuentwickeln. Die ergriffenen Maßnahmen verwandeln den Laden in eine Festung.

Treppensturz einer älteren Person: Der Notarzt meldet bereits auf der Fahrt ins Universitätsklinikum Rostock einen Schockraum an. Und in Kaufbeuren ist die Lage dramatisch. Ein Mann hat sich bei einem Suizidversuch den Bauch aufgeschnitten.

Das medizinische Personal des Elisabeth-Krankenhauses in Mönchengladbach-Rheydt versorgt eine Patientin mit besorgniserregender Atemnot. Und im Ruhrgebiet wurde einer Frau Gewalt angetan. Ihr Ex-Freund hat sie mit seinem Auto mitgeschleift.
In einer Strandbar hat sich jemand an einer Fritteuse verbrannt. Unter normalen Bedingungen dauert der Flug nach St. Ives maximal 15 Minuten.

Die Sendung informiert über alle wichtigen Neuigkeiten aus der Welt. Die Zuschauer bekommen so einen Überblick über den aktuellen Stand verschiedenster Themen wie Gesellschaft, Kultur, Politik, Sport, Wirtschaft und Zeitgeschehen.

p.t: Helicopter ER - Rettung aus der Luft
p.d: Ein Rettungswagen ist mit einem Pkw zusammengestoßen. Dabei wurde eine Sanitäterin schwer verletzt. Einsatzkräfte der Feuerwehr versuchen 20 Minuten, die Frau aus dem Fahrzeug zu befreien. An der Unfallstelle werden und Blutkonserven benötigt.

A mother-and-son team pulls up stakes in Orange County, Calif., to build an off-grid family commune outside Keaau, Hawaii; with the help of a skilled AirCrete instructor, the duo overcomes a learning curve to make their dreams come true.
Understanding how some off-the-grid builds are attempted in the most remote and dangerous places on Earth. These remote locations include deep in Alaska's wilderness and on top of sub-zero glaciers.

Sig gets tough news at sea forcing the Hansens to make a critical decision as John and Andy lend a hand. With wheelhouse ambitions, Jacob hits a wall with Keith on the Wizard. New captain Jack crosses a line when Harley makes a deal with Jake.
A deadly caiman targets Mehgan, but a potentially crippling accident leads to a shocking find. It's a coded message from the past that may bring them closer to gold.

Josh treks the stone-paved Inca Trail, ascending 20,000 ft through the Andes and into the Peruvian Amazon in search of the undiscovered City of Gold. His road to riches takes a detour to the legendary ruins of Machu Picchu.

Josh dives into the Lajas Reef off Panama's coast in search of treasure chests on the sunken flagship of legendary pirate Captain Morgan. His journey takes him to Panama City, and he visits the Panama Canal, a modern marvel.
The Raneys put their ingenuity to the test on a homestead in Hawaii that was destroyed by lava. They need to find a way of protecting it from future eruptions.
There's a nightmare in North Carolina. A couple's ramshackle cabin has exposed wires in the shower livestock decimated by predators. Can the Raneys help?
Chris suffers a spider bite. Slim Pickings' Lee battles dangerous ground on a quad bike. And a big mechanical failure halts Dan and Renee's enterprise.
The Blacklighters are hit with a double dose of disaster. The Bushmen are blindsided by a government decision to shut down thousands of opal claims.
The Poseidon Crew take a gamble on gold ground they've already previously detected. Meanwhile, Levi and Bridget make a rookie mistake, while the Gold Timers manage to catch a thief.
The Ferals confront a gold thief who's raided their lease. The Gold Retrievers explore a promising new lease, while Jacqui and Andrew get their big break.

Phil and Heather journey into the Kentucky wilderness, searching for Sasquatches rumoured to be highly intelligent. They quickly find themselves in a chilling game of cat and mouse as the beasts seem always to stay one step ahead of them.

Months after the Northern California expedition, Bryce, Mireya, and Russell head to Washington after a fresh lead points to a target zone where Bigfoot groups are congregating for an unknown reason. Survivalist Biko Wright joins the hunt.

The team heads to Alaska, America's Last Frontier, to investigate reports of a murderous Sasquatch. Phil and Jess travel deep into the wilderness and have a truly hair-raising close encounter with what locals call 'The Hairy Man'.

A ranch foreman falls out with an old friend over a woman and is then involved in hunting him down when he turns to crime. The Virginian wins the battle for the affections of Molly Wood, and Steve responds to losing in love by aligning himself with a gang of cattle rustlers. The Virginian looks on while a posse catch Steve and hang him, and guilt-ridden, he swears to go after the gang-leader.
Wild west tale about a rancher's search for a ruthless and violent outlaw who has kidnapped his fiancé.

Set during the uprising of the Sioux nation in the late 19th century, when broken treaties and a gold rush saw their tribal territories invaded once again. The film centres on Jim Bridger, a scout at Fort Phil Kearney, from where the 7th Cavalry rides to try and hold the peace, but the brutal slaying of innocents by a sadistic lieutenant sees the Sioux in full cry and only Bridger's cunning can help save the soldiers.

p.d: Stars Eddie Redmayne and Felicity Jones and director James Marsh talk about making the moving romantic drama about the relationship between Stephen and Jane Hawking.

Mal is the manager of England's homeless football team, taking his players to Rome with the hope of being crowned champions of the Homeless World Cup. He brings with them a talented striker, Vinny, who could give them a real chance at winning.

A London cocaine dealer wants to retire with his millions and his health intact, but mob boss Price has other ideas, dragging him into a set-up involving a missing junkie, a million stolen tablets of 'E' and an East European hitman.

A Crime drama following the life of former police detective Carrie Wells who has a rare condition that makes her memory flawless. Every place, conversation and moment of happiness and heartbreak is embedded in her mind forever. She is unable to forget anything, except for one key event: what happened the day her sister was murdered, to which she was witness, years ago. Dylan Walsh also stars.
When a building collapses on one of Mary's witnesses, he is left exposed to outside threats, and Mary must risk her life in order to keep him safe.
Beckett and Castle face the consequences of their decisions during a high-stakes investigation.
A man is murdered while appearing on a reality TV show, prompting Dr Sloan to enter the game undercover.
Mark gets wrapped up in the world of high fashion and designer drugs while tracking down the person responsible for planting a bomb that killed his friend on his wedding day.
When Jessica helps her friend with the launch of a new television show in Aspen, her friend's estranged husband is killed in what appears to be an accident. However, Jessica suspects foul play.
Crime writer and amateur sleuth Jessica Fletcher is invited to the desert town of Gila Junction by a friend who suspects it is the site of dangerous chemical experiments.
Beckett races to find a stolen toxin capable of killing thousands of people and Castle has less than 24 hours to live after being exposed to the chemical weapon.

A respected police officer heads home after a late shift, and a young man who has just moved into his own place relaxes after watching football. How do these routine evenings turn deadly? Were their killings cold-blooded assassinations?
She is an innocent bride-to-be; he's a six-year-old schoolboy; both are on the road, away from home, when they disappear.

Two twenty-year-olds, suffering from great personal tragedies, die mysteriously. One of them is shot while hanging out with friends while the other one disappears and later, her body is found in a staged suicide condition.

Two young women are savagely murdered. One has gone fishing only to turn up beaten and drowned, and the other is a pregnant mother attacked while on the job delivering newspapers. Are strangers responsible, or are the culprits much closer to home?

p.d: A home health care aide's body floats in a rural Connecticut creek. Detective Garritt Kelly joins the investigation to bring justice to a community gripped by fear.

p.d: A farmhand goes missing from a sprawling cattle ranch, but the case takes a sinister turn when his body shows up miles down the Coweeman River.
Millionaire CEO Kim Bailey suspects her employees are stealing from her. When a colleague vanishes, an FBI investigation leads to a deadly conclusion.
After a farmer is found dead on his kitchen floor, everyone on the property becomes a suspect in a complicated investigation that leads to a shocking discovery.

When 32-year-old Adam Chase goes missing, police comb the woods and fields of Ontario County, New York, but come up with nothing; it takes a months-long efforts of a private investigator to at last reveal the truth and Adam's terrifying fate.

Dan and Ella get to know each other better at one of Bali's stunning beach clubs, but this could spell trouble as the two grow closer. Meanwhile, home is on Diags' mind as he decides to bring Jodie to Bali.
A reservation mix-up results in Dawson and Joey sitting at a table with Mitch and Nicole and Andie's condition continues to worsen.
Phoebe protects an abandoned baby boy from a vengeful spirit that has methodically killed all the men in the child's family.

Sonya steps into the spotlight on the show with only one question - join Stephen Mulhern to find out if she will defeat the notoriously tight-fisted Banker and find the courage to play to the very end to become a 100,000-pound winner.
Rylan Clark-Neal hosts as three groups of contestants take on "The Big Sweep".
Graham Norton invites executive assistant Yemi, funeral celebrant Richard and support worker Aimee to take on the Wheel and solve some tricky puzzles for the chance to win up to 50,000 pounds.
Jodie has landed in Bali and Diags is over the moon. Elma says she's happy for them, but seeing them together could be harder than she thought.
The group is shook as they navigate the fallout from the messy breakfast; Gizelle returns to Lake Norman; Mia takes the ladies on a detour to unwind before trying to work things out with Keiarna.

p.t: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills
p.d: Love is in the air for Boz and her new boyfriend, but Dorit and PK can't say the same; Martyn Lawrence Bullard promises to turn Erika's home from sad to sexy; Garcelle reflects on her accomplishments and rebuilding a connection with her oldest son.

Sally Dynevor, Barney Walsh and Zoe Williams all try to guess well-known phrases from the animated clues - if they can "say what they see", they could get the chance to win 50,000 pounds for their chosen charity.
Graham Norton invites customer experience manager Phil, HR manager Jamie-Lee, and hair salon owner Helen to spin the Wheel, solve puzzles and avoid the bankrupts for a possible 50,000 pounds.

Have you ever wondered how clever you are? This is your chance to find out as comedy legend Lee Mack presents the ultimate leveller of a quiz show where the questions are all about logic and common sense and where the whole family can play together - 100 contestants begin every show, but only some of them will get near the chance to answer a question that only one per cent of the country can get right for up to 100,000 pounds.

A cast of carefully selected housemates from all walks of life take up residence in the world's most famous reality TV home for up to six weeks, with cameras capturing their every move and the nation following every twist and turn.

Get closer to the personalities, dynamics and relationships at the heart of the show. Big Brother legend Kate Lawler and podcaster supreme GK Barry host exclusive interviews with evicted Housemates, celebrity fans and special guests.
Peter and Carter go to Africa to get their money back after they are swindled in an e-mail scam. Meanwhile, Brian pursues Meg's friend, Patty.

The year-long investigation into the murder of Yvonne Harrison in a quiet Cotswold village is revitalised with the promise of new evidence. With Morse back on full duties, what exactly is the state of his health?
Bellamy is forced to confront painful memories when he becomes a target for misplaced revenge.

Merton suspects explosives from a local airfield are linked to a robbery, but his hands are tied when a DI pulls rank. Vernon sees a money-spinner when David enters a unique plant in the Aidensfield flower show.

Cheriton falls foul of the establishment and fuels Meryl's jealousy when he clashes with a senior doctor, Ken plans to fleece Harper over decorating the hospital, and Ormerod and Weatherill begin to get closer.

A young man arrives at Leopard's Den claiming to be Du Plessis' son, but when a guest's camera goes missing, Rosie and Danny question his true identity. Evan tries to save an orphaned elephant, and Sarah returns to England for her father's funeral.

Emmerdale is one of Britain's best-loved and highly viewed long-running drama soaps - set in the heart of the beautiful countryside of the Yorkshire Dales, this realistic and down-to-earth drama superbly chronicles the joys and the heartbreaks of a tightly knit countryside community.
Jason is angry that Audrey's financial demands mean Bill can no longer afford to keep him on full-time, while Tom is upset to learn of the new management structure at Lad Rags.
Peter's drinking causes concern when he leaves Simon with Deirdre for the afternoon. Fiz receives a letter from John, and Maria is jealous of Natasha and Tony's relationship.
Merton has to call in CID when armed robbers snatch a woman's diamonds from her neck. Ben shares some unexpected news with Liz while, David basks in his new-found fame.
When an ex-army officer is found dead in his home, suspicion is cast on his money-hungry wife, and Rosie ends up with more admirers than she bargained for when she goes on a blind date.

Lisa Vaisey's sister is found dead in the water, after a family party on the River Tyne. The family are convinced that her death was nothing more than a tragic accident, but Vera and Malcolm aren't so sure.

It is April 1917 and, with most of the men away at the front, Carson is finding it tough maintaining standards in the house. Robert's new valet Henry Lang has just returned from the war, but O'Brien is the only one to notice that he is not well. The suicide of a young officer prompts Isobel to suggest that they convert Downton into a convalescent hospital. Also, Mary hears that Matthew is returning.

Rachel's moment of indiscretion threatens to come back and haunt her when Sean takes a phone call from her recent one-night stand. Janet forces Ade to move in with his new girlfriend and asks her mum Dorothy to take his place. The team investigates the brutal murder of a wealthy man whose double life left him vulnerable to exploitation. Could his son really be the prime suspect?

Rachel resorts to sleeping under her desk in response to Sean's possessiveness but finds a much more comfortable place to rest her head when Janet invites her to stay at her place. Janet prepares to take the next step in her career as a sergeant, but a much younger candidate is given the role.

From our sister channel NOW 70s, the biggest rock 'n' roll rebels. Presented by the man who was there that groovy host from the West Coast Radio 1 legend Rosko!
These are the legendary rock stars that made the 80s! Expect Meat Loaf, Bonnie Tyler, Queen, Bon Jovi, AC/DC, Iron Maiden & loads more!
A 2-hour run through, in order, of top 3 hits from the 80s - all with that rock n roll swagger! Expect plenty of Queen, T'Pau, Bonnie Tyler & Blondie.
A Brazilian woman gets caught with what looks like an implement to snort cocaine after she arrives from New Zealand; Border Force search a Sri Lankan man they believe is in the country illegally.
A convicted drug smuggler returns to Australia after his arrest 15 years ago. A shipment from Korea causes alarm. A man fails to declare seeds in his bags.
At JFK, there is an operation to confiscate synthetic drugs; the officers examine an overweight suitcase.
At the JFK Airport, a passenger is not honest about the reasons for his trip; an agent finds undeclared jewels in a suitcase.
From explosive driving mayhem to daredevil bikers and chaotic landslides, it's all caught on camera.
A teen driver takes officers on a wild, stolen car pursuit, two men are suspected of stealing thousands of dollars of razors, and a domestic call leads to a double arrest.
Indonesian Luwak coffee stopped at Customs; Cambodian woman suspected of illegal immigration; Indian student doesn't declare food.
An entire flight from Vietnam is suspected of drug smuggling; sniffer dog finds a package; Two students with little luggage cause suspicion.
A baffling mysterious passenger; Man exceeds the legal limit for cigarettes; Customs are shocked by two parcels from Thailand.
A man's crooked past resurfaces; Chinese woman has undeclared jewellery; A royal heirloom from England is under scrutiny.
Sisko meets Ezri, the new host of the Dax symbiont, before departing Earth for the planet Tyree with his father, Joseph, and son Jake as he begins his search for Bajor's mythical Orb of the Emissary.
SG-1's search for the Sangraal takes them to Atlantis, where they hope to prevent the Ori from sending more ships through the Supergate.

While on a routine exploration of a new planet, Voyager responds to the distress calls of a Kazon warship. Upon investigation, they find the Kazon ship hobbled by an accident caused by Federation technology - a clear signal that Voyager may be carrying a traitor.
A skittish member of Geordi's engineering staff encounters a bizarre creature while in the process of transporting from another ship.
The team track a bomber who holds a grudge against the legal system, and Danny receives an unexpected visit when his brother drops by.

Níl an crann Nollag tagtha agus caithfidh Thomas, Bruno agus Percy smaoineamh ar phlean anois chun traidisiún Sodor a choinneáil ag imeacht. The Christmas tree hasn't arrived. Thomas, Bruno and Percy must think of a plan to keep the tradition going.
Joe and Ozzy are off to the park to make some deliveries and to take part in a treasure hunt.
At school, some of the cats aren't all that impressed that Flix is a dog, so he embarks on a mission to find his true superpower by turning himself into Super Flix.
Amy shows Zoom how ketchup is one of a special group of liquids that can change how quickly they flow, Mark attempts to walk on an amazing fluid called oobleck.
Maddie and Triggs help Mum babysit their delightfully cute, little neighbour Sally.
Maddie and Triggs discover that the tiniest of indoor sounds can make the biggest noises.
Andy, Jen and Scout embark on a global adventure to Vienna, Austria, on a baby animal mission along the Danube River.
Dylan the florist wants to make the best bouquet ever, but one of his customers wants the rarest flower in the world.
When Mike hears eerie singing and glowing lights in the sea near the lighthouse, he calls Agent Price and Agent Sparkes of The Why Files to check it out.
The team dives into action as Glitch's treasure hunt endangers the Great Barrier Reef.
Mark Labbett joins Rattus for a look at some of history's most brilliant brainboxes.
A sisterly spat leaves Nova without a manager whilst trying to launch her new perfume.

The final day of the Bergin family's adventure has nearly come to an end, and before they say goodbye to bushcraft expert Tom, they explore the surrounding landscape and see what animals shared camp with them during the night.
Steve Backshall tracks cheetahs across Zambia by motorbike, witnessing epic hunting and the challenges faced by this endangered predator.
Pablo has started school. It's wild. It's wonderful. It's next level. From baffling rules to chaotic corridors, Pablo tackles it with imagination and help from his book animal friends.
Dan Souza is showing Drew easy ways to make savoury oatmeal for breakfast. Tyriq Withers tells Drew about his movie `HIM'.
Kellyoke Encore: I Lied/ Eugene Levy/ The Reluctant Recollector/ Mark Ronson/ Pierson Fode/ Kirby Performs 'Jump The Broom'/ Wil: Pig Money For Barn.
Granville is determined to improve Gastric's image in order to match-make him with Madge. His plans take an inspired turn when a salesman returns to town.
Live coverage of Question Time in the Dáil and the latest reactions to political developments, with analysis of proceedings with a panel of guests.

An Irish Lottery draw that works like a traditional game of bingo, with a full house prize of €10,000 and the opportunity to win much more if the player completes their card on or before the Snowball number is drawn.
The latest news and weather at one o'clock.
Following the residents of the small beach town of Summer Bay, as they deal with relationships, family, love, loss, and growing up.
Following the stories from New Zealand's Shortland Street Hospital, where staff and patients deal with love, life, and loss while navigating their personal and professional pursuits.
John Spillane mentors The Donnys and helps them organise a gig in Kilkenny.
Vinny's 30th birthday party is derailed. Patrick asks Oscar for a favour.
Mary looks into a morality violation by Rita Hart's modern dance troupe, while Frankie questions whether they've brought the Spanish Flu to Toronto.
Dermot and Claire aim to help a young family in Palmerstown, Dublin to make the most of the space in their cramped home.
Providing content that challenges, educates and entertains the viewing audience while providing the day's main news stories from a regional, national and international perspective.
The latest national and international headlines with Irish Sign Language (ISL).
The Mulkerrin and Heaney families of the Carna Gaeltacht maintain a centuries-old tradition of pilgrimage by curragh to the ancient oratory on Oileán Mhic Dara.
Axe looks into who caused the breakdown in his dealings in Sandicot, but faces formidable opposition. Chuck digs up dirt on a political rival.
Upon entering parliament, Mussolini decides to change: he wants to be more strategic, diplomatic and a true statesman. However, the Blackshirts end up rebelling.
The king decides to exclude the socialists from the government following continuous strikes and protests. In reaction, Mussolini threatens a fascist insurrection in an attempt to take everything.
Lewis fights to regain consciousness after an accident, while Mike pursues the fleeing suspect, and Mike and Bayliss search through South Beach.
Mike Kellerman, working as a private investigator, shows up in the squad room looking for information on a case he's handling.
Axe assembles a war room in the Hamptons following a disastrous setback, and seeks counsel on how to recoup his losses.
Axe looks into who caused the breakdown in his dealings in Sandicot, but faces formidable opposition. Chuck digs up dirt on a political rival.
Hockey stars Hollander and Rozanov balance fierce rivalry with an intensifying personal connection on and off the ice.
Shane and Ilya keep their secret fling alive while their growing connection is tested by personal and professional pressures.
As Edison's illuminating electricity demonstration sparks conversation, Agnes is determined to uphold the family reputation, George prepares for a legal battle, and Bannister has revenge in mind.
As Bertha is unhappily reminded of her place on her visit to Newport, George gets his day in court, Peggy reveals the truth about her past, and Marian considers her romantic future.
Duke prepares for his long-awaited shot at revenge, while others take matters into their own hands.
Before becoming known as the Bene Gesserit, a powerful Sisterhood works in the shadows to guide the universe.
Ahead of Investor Day, Shiv weighs a proposal from Matsson while Kendall and Roman each try to match Logan's volatile leadership style.
Hoping to work the angles, Kendall and Roman ask Shiv to invite a campaign insider to Logan's pre-election day party.
From some of the most heart-stopping police chases ever seen, to smashing total wipeouts, we've got it all caught on the handy dashboard camera.
A melee at a bar is broken up by two cops who also happen to be best friends; police call fire and EMS to a scene of a severely injured man; police dogs find a man suspected of a hit-and-run.
When an off-duty diplomatic security agent is fatally shot in New York City trying to apprehend someone, the team investigates if there is a connection to his time working in Croatia.

When the deputy commander of an Air National Guard base is kidnapped, the team must work quickly to find the suspect along with stolen ammunition, and Scola questions his own safety in the aftermath of a recent traumatic experience.
The team mobilises to locate a suspect after a deadly series of events affects one of their own; Celina takes on her first case with Bailey's help.

Danny and Baez race against the clock to catch a serial killer targeting young women; Erin and Eddie clash when Eddie intervenes in a murder case and Erin's personal life; Frank must decide how to discipline his grandson.
Immigration makes a shocking discovery under the floorboards of a suburban home. Plus, a couple from the Solomon Islands are caught with seeds in their luggage.
Immigration have to deal with a travelling musician who believes she can see the future. Meanwhile, Bio security discover an odd and possibly sinister concoction in the bag of a traveller.
A man tries to pass the blame onto his travelling companion after being caught by Customs for a very sinister reason; a targeted immigration raid.
Quarantine chases two Chinese passengers trying to smuggle a concealment out of the exit, and customs discovers a concealment of white powder.
Customs deal with an agitated passenger who doesn't want to be searched. Meanwhile, quarantine officers catch a Chinese couple disposing of a high-risk item.
A patrol boat races to rescue a sinking vessel crammed with people, and quarantine officers are left on high alert following an infestation.
A mirror concealing several pallets of heroin arrives at quarantine. Meanwhile, a French backpacker attracts the attention of the customs' sniffer dogs.
Follow Australian Customs and Border Protection officers as they attempt to enforce the country's various quarantine, customs, immigration and finance laws.
From shocking stunts and impatient drivers to night-time nightmares, little terrors, playful pranks and heart-thumping action from the line of duty, we've got it all.

After accidentally breaking Professor Wiseman's cuckoo clock, George decides to explore the inside of the large library clock to see how it works. Also, in the country, George falls in love with neighbour Bill's new pet bunnies.
Faith-Leigh imagines her life as a rugby player when she grows up, with the help of the Job Fairy. She practices the skills that she will need as a member of a rugby team.
Zou offers to look after the shop so Mr Zoey and Zak can go on holiday. Everything's fine until Grandpa's phone goes missing.

Charlie has a lot of post to deliver today, but doesn't have a lot of time. The Mayor is waiting for an important delivery. The question is whether Nino and DeeDee will be able to help Uncle Charlie without using magic.

Nervous in front of the cameras, the shy caracal family is in for a treat today. It will be a breath of fresh air after 11 weeks inside. In the reindeer enclosure, there's a baby boom. Six calves in 10 days, and counting. And there's little protest from this happy pig - proud mum of 11 purebred piglets.

Pádraig Ó Baoighill is the guest. On retiring from Gael Linn, he pursued writing full-time. 'An Capall Dubh & Scéalta Eile' in 2018 is one of his latest works, a collection of short stories, mostly set in the Gaeltacht.
Malcolm's overjoyed when Lois comes down with glandular fever and has to stay in bed for a fortnight, but he catches it too and has to stay in bed with Lois.
When the Cheers gang take on a rival bar in a war of outrageous pranks, they soon become paranoid of all strangers entering the bar, including Boston Red Sox's third baseman Wade Boggs.
From JJ Birchall's Pub in Dublin. Musicians featured are Gerry Harrington, Tom McElvogue and Paddy Kerr. Presented by Peter Browne.
A woman seeks Jessica's help in clearing her son whom she claims was fathered by Jessica's late husband.
How well do we truly know wildlife? Over four years, 150 hidden cameras have collected images that form an impressive documentation from the perspective of the animals.

Paul Murton explores the delights of the Firth of Clyde, a favourite holiday destination for millions of Scots for generations. This was the place where people could enjoy healthy sea breezes, swim in the ocean, mess about in boats and enjoy a glass or two of their favourite tipple.
Al Grant takes to the stage at An Grianán Theatre for a night of country music.
Rory offers to help Logan write an article for the Yale Daily, but she is disappointed when he doesn't invite her to be his date at a book-signing party hosted by his father.
A look at the national and regional weather.
Adolf Hitler has his mind on making Germany into a great empire by expanding eastwards, but his invasion of Poland tips the world into a violent and bloody war.
As peace descends in 1945, survivors relate memories of the Second World War and remember the millions of combatants and civilians killed in the destructive conflict.
The team visit Balmoral, the Queen's private residence in Aberdeenshire. Treasures brought by visitors include a diamond tiara, a giant telescope and a ceramic pot by Pablo Picasso.

Treasures brought by visitors include an 18th century bottle unearthed by a digger, a mirror inspired by Charles Rennie Mackintosh and a remarkable collection of medals awarded to a man who served in both World Wars.
Dave is drawn to a Fiat Uno 45 in "hearing aid beige", a well-known manufacturer's colour, with 36,000 miles on the clock.
Paul hits the road to collect an old navy ambulance that served its time as a holiday camper.

Jungles are mysterious worlds of high drama where extraordinary animal characters struggle to survive in the most competitive place on earth. Flooded forests are home to caiman-hunting Jaguars, and strange dolphins that swim amongst the tree tops, whilst in the dense underworld, ninja frogs fight off wasps and flying dragons soar between trees.
Dave heads to the South Coast to pick up a carefully restored Ford Escort. Derek seeks a forerunner of the Range Rover.
Sheldon and Will are tasked with finding a dream car for 1940s enthusiast Deb.

Paul hits the road to collect an old navy ambulance that served its time as a holiday camper.
A rare Honda S800 sports car from 1967 takes Derek's fancy, and a couple of very different Ford Capris with long histories go head-to-head at the auction.
Featuring a generous morning dose of celebrity interviews, showbiz updates, lifestyle tips and everything else relevant to start the day in an upbeat manner.
A rotating panel comprised of women from the entertainment and journalism worlds discuss issues from a female perspective, from politics and current affairs to all the latest gossip.
The latest headlines from around the world. Followed by a national weather forecast and all the news and weather in your region.
News and weather from across Northern Ireland.

David and his dealer den visit Blackpool, where Tracy Thackray-Howitt gets a very cheeky chappy and Jo Brayshaw is flattered into parting with her cash. Plus, for once, a table full of bling doesn't do it for Henry Nicholls.
Looking for the winning words are Spice Girls super-fan Sid and his wife Shabs, Essex brothers Jake and Dean, and stepdad and stepson Ottis and Rey.

Contestants play a large coin-drop machine, provided they answer questions correctly. Answer incorrectly and the players could be eliminated. The last contestant standing has an opportunity to win the machine's £10,000 jackpot.

Bradley Walsh hosts as four strangers, Phil, Andrea, Mohammed and Kate, come together in the hope that as a team they can take on a Chaser and leave with thousands of pounds. But who will they be in battle against?
News and weather from across Northern Ireland.
The latest headlines from around the world. Followed by a national weather forecast.
After a record-breaking year of heatwaves and drought, Kate Quilton assesses the impact on farmers and food prices and finds out what we can do to keep our shopping bills down.
Charles attempts to comfort a grieving Nicola, Billy confronts Joe about the private funeral plans, and Kev makes his opinion known.
Shona's erratic behaviour arouses concern, Kit encourages Bethany to pursue romance with Ryan, Ross begs for Tyrone's forgiveness, and Summer harbours reservations about Marco.

Pat is 77 years old and searching for the son she placed for adoption when she was just 15. A few years after his adoption, Pat discovered she couldn't have any more children naturally. Now she longs to see her only son again to tell him she has always loved him. Jake has not seen his two paternal siblings Tom and Katie since he was a baby; they seemingly vanished off the face of the earth.
Includes a national weather forecast and the latest news and weather in your region.
The team partners with the stars of 'EastEnders' to bring volunteers together to support a mental health community project in Harlow, Essex.

Single mother Julie Jones became a national news story when she promised to look after her dying friend's children. Overnight Julie's family grew from three children to eight. Nick Knowles and the team travel to Huntingdon where, with the help of the local community, they aim to transform Julie's house into a home for this supersized family. They have just ten days in which to finish the build.

Building an extension to meet the needs of their growing family seemed a straightforward proposition for Neil and Rebecca Smith, but then Neil was made redundant and the couple's youngest child began to display signs of autism. Nick Knowles and the team enlist the aid of the local community to rescue this family. They have just 10 days to complete the build.

A family loves the good bones of their home, but with a fourth child on the way, their cramped living space quickly loses functionality; Drew and Jonathan roll up their crafting sleeves to design an organised home with room for the growing family.

Sweet Week heats up with an Air Fryer Invention Test. The top four cooks will book their spots in the Immunity Challenge, while the creator of the day's best dish will walk away with a massive $5,000 Harvey Norman voucher.
A young girl is reluctant to let the paramedics examine her injured head and a mature student needs medical help.

Hanna and Mike have three kids, two of them are twins born prematurely. One now suffers from cerebral palsy and the other is profoundly deaf. The family house is tiny, and the cramped conditions are making life extremely difficult and at times dangerous for the growing boys. Nick Knowles and DIY SOS team call on friends, family and the local community to come to the aid of this young family and build a single storey extension in just nine days.
Nick Knowles and the team enlist the help of the local community in Aberystwyth to renovate a home for a builder with a brain tumour.

p.t: The Shift: Women on the Force
p.d: Road Policing Officer Emma Bainbridge pursues a pack of hounds running wild on a major A-road. Acting Inspector Julie Battle must tread delicately when she handles a potential suicide.

p.t: The Shift: Women on the Force
p.d: Police Community Support Officers Lucy Burgoyne and Olivia Freeman respond to reports of a man in the river, while Chief Inspector Fiona Willey is on the hunt for drug dealers.

p.t: Rescued Chimpanzees of the Congo With Jane Goodall
p.d: Dr Rebeca Atencia releases the first two chimps to their new semi-wild existence on the sanctuary's new islands, then sets out to rescue an illegally kept pet mandrill, but encounters resistance from angry villagers.

p.t: Rescued Chimpanzees of the Congo With Jane Goodall
p.d: The sanctuary's islands are now home to nearly a hundred chimps. Dr Rebeca Atencia rescues two chimps from terrible conditions in neighbouring Angola and brings them to live at the sanctuary.

p.t: Gorillas Revisited with Sir David Attenborough
p.d: While filming the 1979 documentary `Life on Earth', David Attenborough experienced something he'll never forget: very personal interaction with mountain gorillas in Rwanda. In `Gorillas Revisited', Sir David recounts how he and his crew managed to show gorillas for almost the first time on television and how the mountain gorillas of Rwanda are now considered a successful conservation story. Included in the special is a tribute to zoologist Dian Fossey, who for years studied the remarkable creatures while living among them and protecting them from poachers. She was murdered in 1985.

Captain Dan enlists 11-year-old son Calvin as a mascot, but after a bumper day's fishing, finds the processing plant struggling to cope.
Africa's predators rule supreme on land, but there is no beating the battles fought under its seas.
The staff and animals rejoice as the long and frigid Michigan winter finally comes to an end.
As the explosion of a railway bridge heralds a new phase of reconstruction, officers help a woman who fell on an escalator.
Autumn transforms the mountainsides of the Carpathians into sweeping carpets of bronze, amber and gold. The forests echo with the powerful roars. (S1 Ep3)
Over the decades, mountain landscapes undergo numerous transformations. In Germany, photographs taken at different times bear witness to this metamorphosis.

Following a monsoon flood, the Wildlife SOS team is called out on a dangerous mission to extract a crocodile flushed down a well. The race is on to reunite a litter of jackal puppies with their missing mother.
A reindeer requires risky surgery, and lynx kitten vaccination turns into a hunt through the underbrush.
After checking a ranch's elk bulls who aren't showing signs of going into rut as expected, Michelle heads to the Southeast Alaska State Fair to have fun with her daughters.
A naughty red panda mum develops a limp. Find out if she needs a day off from the cubs, or if she is really in pain.
Sir David Attenborough narrates an underwater look at the ocean giants thriving in the coldest place on Earth, Antarctica. Among them is a huge and legendary squid.
The Okavango River empties into the usually barren Kalahari Desert, creating a unique ecosystem teeming with diverse wildlife in this incredible desert delta.
Experts investigate the first shark attacks ever recorded on Bali's coast.
The NWS homesteaders battle to survive and thrive in an unforgiving winter wilderness.
Africa is a land where life competes tooth and claw, and predator and prey have evolved to blend in.
The Poseidon Crew hope to pull in enough gold to keep the team together, the Gold Devils push their equipment to failure, and the Ferals battle through blistering heat to smash their season target.

After sinking a new shaft to save their backs, The Bushmen are stonewalled by impenetrable rock. The Mooka Boys are finally ready to start tunnelling toward black opal glory, until their last working machine suffers a catastrophic breakdown.
When Mark is hospitalised after a mining accident, Paul and John must work overtime on two separate claims to scrape together enough opal to survive the week.

First to arrive at the barn are Judith Holliman and her son James. They have brought a dear old friend, a stuffed owl called Wol. Judith clearly remembers him peeking out of her Christmas stocking when she was just a few years old, and they have been inseparable ever since. He was a gift from her beloved grandmother, who helped to raise her, and Wol is a constant reminder of her grandmother's love.
In Telford, a tractor and motorbike provide double the trouble and the double the opportunity for Henry. Can he get the two jobs done?
The boys head over to Woodcote where Nick waits with an array of motor memorabilia. Henry takes home hedge cutters, signs, oil dispensers and more.
Henry Cole and the team restore a 1950s Massey Ferguson combine, racing to tame the beast and bring in the harvest.

p.t: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
p.d: The boys visit Swindon and Chippenham to seek out more items to turn for a profit. Henry finds and restores a much maligned BSA Ariel 3 moped and Simon gives a Ford Transit gearbox a new lease of life.

Angus aims to help a couple recovering from life-threatening illnesses start a new life in a new home, if he can sell their huge collection of Glenn Miller Vinyl and V-discs. And then he gets his hands on some nice jugs, in a home with a pub in it!

Angus helps a woman who needs money to pay for her elderly mother's care home but has no idea what's hiding in her jewellery box. Also, after a life-altering event on holiday, a couple must raise funds to make their home wheelchair-accessible.
Catherine ditches the classic car to travel in a steam loco while James gets into a spin at a pottery. The pressure mounts for one expert at the penultimate auction in Bedford.
Robbie Adams delivers supplies to livestock farmers, rookie trucker Pablo Gwadu takes on his biggest challenge yet, and oversize specialist Robbie Bush hauls luxury cabins across Victoria.
Shane and Rusty position themselves for a once-in-a-lifetime deal. Newcomers the Gold Drifters hunt for a long lost gold field, and Sheryl and Simon face the biggest decision of their mining careers.

Resident clock expert Steve Fletcher restores an 18th-century wall clock that is a much-loved heirloom from the owner's grandfather. It hasn't ticked for five years, will Steve get the clock to work again? Caner Rachael South restores a beautiful wicker cradle that has been in use for generations.
How do they keep the cars of Daytona on track for 24 hours of high speed racing? How do they turn the sweetest sugar cane into world-renowned Caribbean rum?
From dresses fit for royalty to dresses that are barely there, our brides took their shopping to a whole new level this season. Randy recalls the looks that killed and the dresses that thrilled!

Two off-duty policemen show extreme bravery as they try and stop an armed robbery at a jeweller's in Newark, and the apparent suicide of a mother-of-three raises the suspicions of her family and the police.
A venerable young man, allowed to live independently for the first time, is murdered in cold blood at the hands of a couple playing a truly warped game of deceit and lies.

p.t: On the Case With Paula Zahn
p.d: Can police identify the killer of a young mother based on her frantic words in a disconnected 911 call?

When young professional Sasha Samsudean disappears after a night out in downtown Orlando, Florida, detectives turn to video surveillance footage to unravel the mystery and bring Sasha's killer to justice.
Detective Chief Superintendent Gull is faced with five young murdered women who are found in the Suffolk countryside; the ensuing manhunt becomes an international media circus.

Carol-Ann and James Sharp seem like a match made in heaven, but behind the veneer hides a monster in plain sight; loved ones close to the couple sit down for the first time on camera to make sense of a murder that none of them saw coming.
Four best friends, two married couples, multiple sordid secrets, and one betrayal that leads to murder; with exclusive interviews and never-before-aired home movie footage.
After the murder of 28-year-old Kiara Livingston, Aurora, Colorado, police uncover inconsistent witness accounts and buried truths.

In Prestatyn, a woman's anger over a neighbourhood dispute leads her to wreak revenge on a family with tragic consequences. And the disappearance of a woman in her mid-fifties leads to a revelation beyond her family's worst nightmares.
On March 27, 2015, Tierra Hall says goodbye to her mother for the last time; 24 hours later, the teenager's dead body is discovered outside an abandoned house.
A student suddenly vanishes after her shift at work. However, CCTV footage shows her last movements, revealing the chilling reason for her disappearance.

A missing persons report leads police to a career criminal and his girlfriend. They uncover a twisted world of illicit schemes, macabre fantasies, and a puppet master manipulating young women down a dark path of sex, drugs and exploitation.
In Nebraska, a group of teenagers venture into the adult world of 'partner swapping', but soon find they are flirting with disaster after one of them ends up dead.
Amy Lord, a 24-year-old former cheerleader, goes missing. CCTV footage from ATMs and outside her home captures when she was taken by her killer.

From the dry plains of the interior come the most recognizable images of Australia, the monolithic red rock of Uluru, the languid, bounding Red Kangaroo. The Arid Heart of Australia is vast and iconic.
A female sloth bear with two cubs searches for food and protects her cubs from leopards in the midst of the summer heat and tropical storms.
Bec patches up a bitten koala with the new vets, Ruby and Kerryn, soothing a pack of itchy possums, while rescue officer Dani encounters a pair of trapped kookaburras needing to be freed.
Alison devises a plan to rescue Dodger, a capuchin monkey in dire need of rehoming; wildlife vet Nic Masters is at the park to carry out health checks on recently arrived capuchins Matty and Louis.
Alison and Jeremy come up with a cunning plan to collect Dodger the capuchin.
A complex web of relationships rules all life on earth, all species are interconnected, none can survive in isolation. While some relationships are one-sided, others are mutually beneficial.
Dr Barry helps two fleet fliers with wing injuries, and the bird nursery fills to the rafters with hungry babies needing round-the-clock care.

A bookshop owner finds love when she agrees to review a famous author's new novel.

Tras treinta años de tranquilidad, los fantasmas y demonios han vuelto a Nueva York para aterrorizar a los ciudadanos. Esta vez, una investigadora de lo paranormal, una física, una ingeniera nuclear y una trabajadora del metro conformarán un equipo para detenerlos.
Descubra el mundo apasionado y desconocido del rodaje y todos los secretos que no se muestran en la televisión.
Actores y cineastas visionarios comparten detalles y aspectos memorables durante la creación de cada película.
Un equipo de militares y un científico parten hacia un planeta desconocido a través de una puerta estelar descubierta en una excavación en Egipto.

June es una chica imaginativa que se encuentra en el País de las Maravillas, un parque de diversiones que creó en su mente. Con el parque en desorden, se une a un grupo de animales para intentar salvar el lugar antes de que se pierda para siempre.

p.t: Bob Esponja: Un héroe fuera del agua
p.d: Bob Esponja realiza una búsqueda para descubrir una receta robada que lo lleva a otra dimensión, otro mundo, donde vive aventuras junto a un pirata.

Cuando los tesoros más grandes del mundo, incluido el diamante de la Pantera Rosa, son robados, solamente un hombre puede resolver el misterio: Clouseau. Junto con su compañero Ponton y un equipo de detectives internacionales, el inepto detective debe atrapar al ladrón y recuperar los artefactos, sin provocar muchos daños colaterales en el proceso.

Cuatro sagaces inversores intentan sacar provecho de la crisis económica que comenzó en el año 2008, pero sus inversiones de riesgo les acaban conduciendo al lado más tenebroso de la economía, donde nadie es quien parece.

Es el primer año de la ocupación alemana de Francia. El oficial aliado, teniente Aldo Raine, ensambla un equipo de soldados judíos para cometer actos violentos en contra de los nazis, incluyendo la toma de cabelleras. Él y sus hombres unen fuerzas con Bridget von Hammersmark, una actriz alemana y agente encubierto, para derrocar a los líderes del Tercer Reich. Sus destinos convergen con la dueña de teatro Shosanna Dreyfus, quien busca vengar la ejecución de su familia.

p.t: La verdad sobre la inteligencia artificial
p.d: A medida que las computadoras continúen evolucionando a una velocidad cada vez mayor, alcanzarán la capacidad de diseñar y programar por sí mismas.
Un detective aficionado roba una máquina capaz de grabar, almacenar y mostrar los recuerdos de otra persona para resolver con ella el enigma de quién asesinó al inventor de este artilugio.
Dos empleados de un club de striptease, obsesionados con el sexo, comienzan una relación que culmina en muerte.

Joanna y Carl Dutcher anuncian la llegada del Año Nuevo con su nieto. Días después, sus cadáveres son hallados; la búsqueda del asesino conduce a la policía a un grupo siniestro que amenaza a toda la comunidad.
Cuando una mentira se sale de control, un día de celebración familiar se convierte en una verdadera pesadilla.

Cuando un joven infante de la marina desaparece, los agentes del NCIS descubren un trágico misterio que impacta a una base naval de Virginia Beach. Una aventura amorosa por Internet tiene como resultado el asesinato de una víctima inocente.

Un tiroteo masivo aterroriza a los habitantes de un pueblo dos días después de la Navidad. Después de matar a dos personas y herir a muchas más, arrestan al homicida. Cuando la policía investiga lo ocurrido, destapa la mayor masacre familiar vista.
En la zona residencial más cara de Manhattan, un anciano y excéntrico coleccionista de arte aparece estrangulado en medio de sus inestimables tesoros.

p.t: The Real Murders of Orange County
p.d: Los investigadores que trabajan en el caso sin resolver del asesinato de un millonario del condado de Orange, descubren una caja de viejas grabaciones que revelan secretos, lo que les lleva a atrapar al asesino.

p.t: The Real Murders of Orange County
p.d: Un estudiante universitario es apuñalado hasta la muerte después de un concierto en el campus. La policía cree que es un asunto personal. La resolución nueve años después resulta ser más oscura.

Un asesino en serie capta a sus víctimas en bares de ambiente gay y deja tras de sí un reguero de cadáveres por todo el sur de los Estados Unidos. Los investigadores están desesperados, hasta que el criminal comete un error que lo delata.
La desaparición de una persona rica en el sur de Florida se torna enseguida un caso de homicidio cuando la policía descubre el plan de la asesina.
Asesinan a una mujer joven en su habitación y la evidencia parece apuntar a un claro sospechoso. Sin embargo, pasan treinta años hasta que se descubre al verdadero asesino.
Una mujer rica de 85 años es apuñalada en su sótano, lo que lleva a la policía a una investigación internacional que descubre secretos diabólicos, vidas dobles y un asesino que nadie vio venir.
Una aflicción de hipos le da a una adolescente sus 15 minutos de fama, pero cuando desaparecen los luces ella busca su adrenalina en una relación con un chico malo y lo lleva a su muerte.
Un asesinato por encargo acaba terriblemente mal, pero un vídeo puede ser la clave para saber el porqué de todo.

Un complejo turístico en Reno se convierte en el centro de un misterio cuando desaparece un profesor universitario. La policía descubre que las respuestas pueden estar enterradas bajo las arenas del desierto a kilómetros de distancia.
Cassandra se ve envuelta en una situación que pone en peligro su vida, así que Alberg y el Departamento de Policía de Gibson se ponen manos a la obra para encontrar al culpable.

Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A veces los problemas del día a día pueden solucionarse con un poco de ayuda milagrosa. Esta exitosa serie muestra casos de la vida real en los cuales los protagonistas se enfrentan a grandes encrucijadas o a situaciones terribles, y no les queda más remedio que pedir un milagro. Es allí cuando la fe se pone a prueba y se vuelve poderosa, pues demuestra que de la situación más terrible se puede salir. Pensado para quienes creen que la fe mueve montañas, esta conmovedora serie muestra la manera en la que los protagonistas se encomiendan a la Virgen Morena buscando resolver sus dificultades.
